name: Liquid Briefing - M2 one article to audio

parameters.content:
## Milestone 2 - one article to audio with claim-level sources
All switches live in **CONFIG** at the top of *Prepare article & request*.
1. Run as is: mock LLM, no audio -> must pass.
2. Set TEST_MODE to `bad_quote`, `wrong_basis`, `advice_in_script` -> *Build script & gate* must throw "TTS BLOCKED".
3. `USE_MOCK_LLM: false` + OpenAI credential on *OpenAI extract claims* -> real extraction (fictional fixture only).
4. `SYNTHESIZE_AUDIO: true` + voice id + Header Auth credential (name `xi-api-key`) on *ElevenLabs TTS* -> MP3 in *Package briefing*.
FICTIONAL INPUT ONLY until real-data processing is confirmed. Execution history stores article text.
